from pathlib import Path
import json, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET, zipfile
root=Path('inputs/inputs') if Path('inputs/inputs/brief.txt').exists() else Path('inputs')
print('INPUT_ROOT',root)
print('BRIEF', (root/'brief.txt').read_text())
print('SAMPLES', (root/'samples.json').read_text())
for p in sorted((root/'baselines/audiveris-enlarged').glob('*')):
 if p.suffix=='.krn':
  print('\nKERN_SOURCE',p);print(p.read_text())
 elif p.suffix in ('.mxl','.musicxml'):
  if p.suffix=='.mxl':
   with zipfile.ZipFile(p) as z:
    names=[n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('.xml') and not n.startswith('META-INF/')]
    doc=ET.fromstring(z.read(names[0]))
  else: doc=ET.parse(p).getroot()
  print('XML_SOURCE',p,'HARMONIES', [ET.tostring(h,encoding='unicode') for h in doc.findall('.//harmony')])
print('WORKSPACE', [p.name for p in Path('.').iterdir()])
